author: asimovDev
text:
I am attempting this with a 100 MB GameMaker (HoloCure) game to make mobile and console ports for fun. Because it uses YYC[0] instead of running in a VM which is how GameMaker games usually work (to my crude understanding of the issue) I have to reverse engineer it instead of just extracting assets and putting them into a project template.

I am using Qwen 3.8 27B-8bit in oMLX and Pi agent with GhidraMCP on my MacBook M3 Max. So far it ran for like 10 hours total and I haven't checked in on it much but it seems to have extracted the audio assets successfully and wrote a whole bunch of helper scripts for Ghidra to extract YYC functions which took several hours to run. I put the project on hold cause I didn't want to keep running it at 100% fans for hours every day. It blew through ~200k context of the model 3 times by now. I am not confident in this project, especially because I have very little experience doing grown up reverse engineering that isn't decompiling a C# or Android apps so I can't really guide it.

0 - https://manual.gamemaker.io/lts/en/Settings/YoYo_Compiler.ht...
